meaning:
1) to represent, liken, be like
1a) (Niphal) to liken, be like, be similar
1b) (Hiphil) to compare
1c) (Hithpael) to become like

renderings.kjv: Wherefore they that speak in proverbs

renderings.bsb: or I will be like those
To whom will you compare Me

renderings.kjv: and they shall no more use it as a proverb
ye shall not have occasion any more to use

elsewhere.note: Therefore those who speak in proverbs say, “Come to Heshbon. Let the city of Sihon be built and established;
He has cast me into the mire. I have become like dust and ashes.
To you, Yahweh, I call. My rock, don’t be deaf to me, lest, if you are silent to me, I would become like those who go down into the pit.
They all will answer and ask you, “Have you also become as weak as we are? Have you become like us?”
